name: Cardinal
source:
The person who was the first to call Mina "Irregular".
Cardinal seems to know some parts about the story of every person in the house and is definitely hiding some substantial secrets. He usually does not appear in front of the Mina and the others because somebody forces him to live in one of the basements of the vast mansion. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
